paragraphs: First create a Daon Identity Verifier connection (holding the OIDC client credentials, endpoints and the enrol process definition). Then copy its resource ID (the id shown in the connection details / console URL) and provide it here as the Daon Verifier ID, along with the login process definition to send as acr_values during login and password recovery.

fields.hint: Provide a unique name for the connection.
Resource ID (UUID) of the Daon Identity Verifier connection whose OIDC client credentials and endpoints this authenticator uses.

Daon process definition used for the login and password-recovery (re-verification) flows, sent as acr_values in the format <Name:Version>. Enrolment uses the enrol process definition configured on the referenced Daon Identity Verifier.

quickStart.heading: Add Daon TrustX Authenticator
quickStart.subHeading: Follow the steps below to add Daon TrustX login (re-verification) to your application.

steps.title: Configure the connection
steps.content: Provide the Daon Verifier ID (resource ID of the Daon Identity Verifier connection) and the Login Process Definition on the Settings tab. The OIDC client credentials, endpoints and scopes are resolved from the referenced Daon Identity Verifier connection.

steps.title: Map attributes
steps.content: On the Attributes tab, map Daon verified claims (e.g. given_name, family_name, birthdate) to WSO2 local claims. These drive verification.

steps.title: Add Daon TrustX to a login flow
steps.content: Add this Daon TrustX Authenticator to an application's Login Flow as a step after the user is identified, to re-verify users already enrolled with the referenced Daon Identity Verifier. Enrolment (registration / invited-user) is driven by the Daon Identity Verifier connection itself.
